IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Health & Long-Term Care (originally sponsored by Senators Keiser, Thibaudeau, Kline and Kohl-Welles)

Bill.BriefDescription: Making available optional insurance coverage to dependent children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing insurance coverage to dependentchildren; adding a new section to chapter 41.05 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 48.20 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 48.21RCW; adding a new section to chapter 48.44 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 48.46 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any plan offered to public employees under this chapter mustoffer each public employee the option of covering any unmarrieddependent of the employee: (a) Under the age of twenty-five; or (b)under the age of thirty and a veteran, as defined in RCW 41.04.007,regardless of whether the dependent is enrolled in an educationalinstitution. (2) Any employee choosing under subsection (1) of this section tocover a dependent who is: (a) Age twenty through twenty-three and nota registered student at an accredited secondary school, college,university, vocational school, or school of nursing; or (b) age p. 1 SSB 6186twenty-four through twentynine, shall be required to pay the full costof such coverage.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any disability insurance contract that provides coverage for asubscriber's dependent must offer the option of covering any unmarrieddependent: (1) Under the age of twenty-five; or (2) under the age ofthirty and a veteran, as defined in RCW 41.04.007, regardless ofwhether the dependent is enrolled in an educational institution.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any group disability insurance contract or blanket disabilityinsurance contract that provides coverage for a participating member'sdependent must offer each participating member the option of coveringany unmarried dependent: (1) Under the age of twenty-five; or (2)under the age of thirty and a veteran, as defined in RCW 41.04.007, regardless of whether the dependent is enrolled in an educationalinstitution.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any individual health care service plan contract that providescoverage for a subscriber's dependent must offer the option of coveringany unmarried dependent: (a) Under the age of twenty-five; or (b)under the age of thirty and a veteran, as defined in RCW 41.04.007, regardless of whether the dependent is enrolled in an educationalinstitution. (2) Any group health care service plan contract that providescoverage for a participating member's dependent must offer eachparticipating member the option of covering any unmarried dependent:(a) Under the age of twenty-five; or (b) under the age of thirty and aveteran, as defined in RCW 41.04.007, regardless of whether thedependent is enrolled in an educational institution.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any individual health maintenance agreement that providescoverage for a subscriber's dependent must offer the option of coveringany unmarried dependent: (a) Under the age of twenty-five; or (b)under the age of thirty and a veteran, as defined in RCW 41.04.007, regardless of whether the dependent is enrolled in an educationalinstitution. (2) Any group health maintenance agreement that provides coveragefor a participating member's dependent must offer each participatingmember the option of covering any unmarried dependent: (a) Under theage of twenty-five; or (b) under the age of thirty and a veteran, asdefined in RCW 41.04.007, regardless of whether the dependent isenrolled in an educational institution.
